subject: RFP: Helios multi-tenant segmentation - SIG/SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Simon Hart <simon.hart@helios-sys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@helios-sys.com, legal-ops@helios-sys.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence - Helios multi-tenant segmentation

Vivek,

Thanks for taking this — Helios is running a security and compliance review as part of a larger procurement (RFP HLX-2379). Our primary ask is that you provide a concise mapping and evidence set showing how Redwood satisfies SIG/SOC2/ISO controls for multi-tenant segmentation and data separation. Specific items we need to validate: 

- Logical separation between tenant workloads (networking, process isolation).
- Data segmentation at rest and in transit; proof of encryption and key custody model.
- Backup/restore scope: are snapshots tenant-scoped or pooled?
- Customer-configurable data retention and deletion workflows.
- Telemetry/observability: what logs are provided and redaction capabilities.
- Third-party/hosting attestations (public SOC2 report, ISO certs) and any subprocessor list.

Can you provide an initial deliverable (control crosswalk + sample artifacts) by Dec 20 so we can feed into our legal and security review? Also please flag any gating items that would require an exception or SLA change.

Procurement deadline for vendor shortlisting is Dec 22 — if a short call helps we can set 20 minutes.

Regards,
Simon Hart
Head of Vendor Assurance
Helios Systems
[simon.hart@helios-sys.com]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Simon Hart <simon.hart@helios-sys.com>
Cc: procure@helios-sys.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence - Helios multi-tenant segmentation

Simon — thank you for the clear ask. We can absolutely produce a compact evidence packet addressing each bullet. Proposed plan: 

1) Control crosswalk (SIG v1.9 / SOC2 Common Criteria / ISO 27001) with Redwood control IDs mapped to Helios requirements — delivery: 48 hours.
2) Evidence samples: tenant isolation architecture diagram, access inventory snapshot, sample KMS key proof (redacted), and our SOC2 report link — delivery: 72 hours.
3) Telemetry sample: sanitized audit log extract and explanation of retention + redaction options.
4) Subprocessor list + ISO/SOC links and attestation notes.

Attachments included in this reply (stubs):
- redwood-soc2-control-map-v2.xlsx (control crosswalk)
- kms-keyproof-sample.pdf (redacted key proof example)
- access-inventory-snapshot.csv (sanitized)

I will also upload a full sig-response-packet.zip to a secure drive and share a link. If you need any live demo of tenant separation (short screen-share), we can schedule a 20-minute slot — I have availability Thu 16:00-17:00 PT or Mon morning next week.

Gating items to flag up front: 
- For cryptographic proof of key custody, we will provide HSM-backed key metadata but cannot share private material; we can arrange an on-call redaction walkthrough.
- If Helios requires tenant-dedicated hardware (physical isolation), that is not part of our standard hosted model and would be an enterprise / dedicated deployment conversation.

I’ll coordinate internal owners and circulate the drive link when the packet is ready.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

[attachment: kms-keyproof-sample.pdf (PDF, 140KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 13:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence - Helios multi-tenant segmentation — takeaways & owners

Team — forwarding Helios request (see below). I’m owning the response coordination. Please take the following actions and reply-confirm by EOD today: 

- Neha: Pull the SOC2 artifact set (system description, control narratives, recent test results). Assemble a short README that maps to the control crosswalk; target: Dec 16 EOD.
- Kimberly: Prepare the KMS/HSM metadata and the redaction script output for the sample proof PDF we attached. Confirm whether we can provide additional HSM attestations (vendor statement). Target: Dec 16 noon.
- Jonas: Export a 48-hour sanitized audit log sample (showing tenant-scoped events only) and a short doc describing log retention, rotation, and access controls. Target: Dec 16 EOD.
- Security ops: If anyone on the ops side needs to run a tenant isolation demo, please flag availability.

Keep replies concise — we need to get the packet assembled and the secure Drive link sent to Helios by Dec 17 to give their legal team time. I’ll stage the sig-response-packet.zip and the crosswalk in the shared folder.

On Tue, Dec 14, 2027 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Simon — thank you for the clear ask. We can absolutely produce a compact evidence packet addressing each bullet. Proposed plan:...

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Simon Hart <simon.hart@helios-sys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@helios-sys.com, legal-ops@helios-sys.com
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2027 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence - Helios multi-tenant segmentation

Vivek — this looks good, and the proposed schedule aligns with our timeline. A couple quick clarifications before we proceed: 

1) For the KMS/HSM metadata: can you confirm whether Redwood uses customer-scoped keys or platform-managed keys by default, and provide the HSM vendor name used for key wrapping? We do not need private key material — metadata is fine.
2) On backups: please confirm whether snapshots are logically tenant-scoped or if restoration is team-scoped (we need assurance around targeted restore).
3) Can you include a short statement about data deletion workflow (how long objects persist, where deletion requests surface in audit logs)?

We’d also like a 20-minute call on Tue Dec 21 at 10:00 AM PT to review the packet and handle any legal clarifications. If that works please send a calendar invite and the Drive link; our legal team will upload an NDA if needed (we can exchange via DocuSign).

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — procurement is on a tight cadence.

Regards,
Simon Hart
Head of Vendor Assurance
Helios Systems
